claim: The software renderer draws the part of a wall-aligned sprite that runs inside a post or wall over that post. A rail must stop at the post's face, not run into it.
evidence: Seen in Gravesend's shot-lamp and railing work, 2026-11-25 (projects/blood-city/level/shot_lamps.py).
use: Cut rails, beams and bars at the faces of what they meet.
